metadata.release_profile: Workspace release profile with fat LTO and one codegen unit; stripped through the pinned Nix package rules.
metadata.runtime: Wasmi 2.0.2; CompilationMode::Eager; std, validate and auto-dispatch; 16 MiB linear-memory limit; fuel enabled.
metadata.signing: Ad-hoc; hardened runtime; no additional entitlements; no notary submission.
metadata.archive: ditto ZIP with the app as the archive root, matching the updater packaging format.
metadata.limits: Footprint only. No app launch, query latency, cancellation latency, peak memory, idle cost, or runtime adoption is measured.
metadata.minimum_guest: Minimal ABI-v1 guest returning protocol-v2 empty results. The fixed reply correlates only with request_id=minimal-probe-1 and generation=1. The footprint script does not execute it.
metadata.currency_guest: Offline currency fixture included only to measure a second realistic guest; it is not registered or shipped as a product feature.

notes: runtime-no-guests is the actual integrated host with plugin resources removed after the Nix build.
The four runtime variants use the same integrated executable; only bundled guest resources differ.
The minimal guest is an ABI and protocol fixture; the footprint script bundles it but does not execute it.
runtime-calculator-currency bundles two realistic guests for footprint accounting, but does not register the currency command.
App bytes sum regular files; ZIP bytes include the signed app directory and ZIP metadata.
